# Use storeToken to join message bytes to database headers during compaction

A storeToken identifies a message within one store and is opaque to callers: mbox currently uses an offset; Maildir uses a filename. FolderCompactor maps token to message key before scanning. It discards store messages with no matching database header. When a retained message moves, OnMessageRetained writes its new token and size into the header. Local folders update messageSize; IMAP and news update offlineMessageSize. A missing token means no local copy. Do not treat message keys as mbox offsets.

Scope: Folder compaction.

Paths:

- `mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgPluggableStore.idl`
- `mailnews/base/src/FolderCompactor.cpp`
